title: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Anime's New Trailer Unveils October 11 Debut, Theme Songs
content: Toei revealed on Wednesday the October 11 premiere for the Dragon Ball Super: Beerus television anime series along with a new "Super Surge" trailer, visual, and the theme song artists. The trailer previews the ending theme song "Kan Peki No Peki" by VK Blanka and the opening theme song "ONOGAMI" by MEGATERA･ZERO.
author: ANN

title: Two Years Ago, One Piece Entered Its Final Phase With Its Biggest Arc Ever
content: Warning: This article contains spoilers from the One Piece manga! Although One Piece entered its Final Saga in the Egghead Arc, the story truly begins to head towards its ending in the ongoing Elbaph Arc.
author: ComicBook

title: Dandadan Studio’s Biggest Reboot Already Has a Finale Date
content: Science SARU is one of the most renowned animation studios in Japan, known for several acclaimed shows and films with unique animation and exceptional storytelling. Its flagship series, Dandadan , debuted in 2024 and made the studio popular around the globe after it went viral.
author: ComicBook

title: Ten Kashiwa, Kai Noshigami Launch New Manga
content: Kodansha 's Magazine Pocket announced on X (formerly Twitter ) on August 27 that Ten Kashiwa ( My Little Sister Stole My Fiancé ) will launch a new series with artist Kai Noshigami titled Utomare Kyūjo wa Ryūō ni Aisareru (The Ostracized Palace Maid is Loved by the Dragon King) on the platform on September 4.
author: ANN

title: 3 Upcoming Anime That Could Fill the Void Left by Solo Leveling in 2027
content: Solo Leveling has created an epic identity ever since the anime first debuted in 2024, and its second season, released the following year, made the anime even better. Ever since then, fans have been waiting for the anime to make its comeback.
author: ComicBook

title: Dragon Ball Super Remake Confirms Release Date With New Trailer – Watch
content: Dragon Ball Super is coming back this Fall with a brand new remake anime series , and Dragon Ball Super: Beerus has set a release date with a new trailer and poster showing it all off.
author: ComicBook

title: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus New Trailer Previews Opening and Ending Themes, October 11 Premiere
content: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus anime revealed its theme songs in the new “SUPER SURGE” trailer, along with an October 11 premiere date. The series was previously confirmed to release Fall 2026, slowly leading up to the upcoming Dragon Ball Super: The Galactic Patrol (Moro Arc) anime.
author: Anime Corner

title: Atsu Benino's Hōkago Voca-Ken de! Manga Ends
content: This year's 40th issue of Shogakukan 's Weekly Shonen Sunday magazine announced on Wednesday that Atsu Benino 's Hōkago Voca-Ken de! (Afterschool at the Vocaloid Research Club) manga will end in the magazine's next issue on September 9.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action High School Family: Kokosei Kazoku Film Reveals Theme Song Artist, Trailer, Poster
content: The official website for the live-action film of Ryō Nakama 's High School Family: Kokosei Kazoku ( Kōkōsei Kazoku ) manga announced the theme song artist in a new trailer on Wednesday. The trailer previews the theme song "Kore mo Seishun da" (This is Also Youth) by Yuzu.
author: ANN

title: One Piece’s Elbaph Arc Is Ignoring the Character With the Most Potential, And It’s a Shame
content: One Piece manga is currently depicting the Elbaph arc, which even the anime has caught up with. However, the manga is now deep into the arc, featuring an epic battle against what many believe to be the final villain of the series.
author: ComicBook
